categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in photovoltaic (PV) component manufacturing, PV system products, and energy storage system production and sales, along with PV power station engineering construction. Its business segments include PV module production, large-scale energy storage systems, residential energy storage products, PV system products including inverters and storage PCS, and EPC services for power station projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PV technologies such as N-type TOPCon cells, HJT heterojunction cells, BC back-contact cells, and large-size silicon wafers. It also develops innovative products like SMBB Ultra busbar technology, reflective film technology, and four-terminal perovskite tandem cells. Manufacturing methods include automated and intelligent production lines, liquid cooling for energy storage systems, and integrated battery management systems. The company emphasizes R&D in battery materials, energy management systems, and inverter technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include commercial, industrial, and residential users globally, with a strong presence in North America, Europe, Australia, Southeast Asia, and emerging markets like Latin America and Japan. The company serves PV project developers, EPC contractors, and end-users requiring integrated solar and storage solutions. Major clients include global utilities and large-scale energy investors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with production bases in China, Thailand, Vietnam, the United States, and other countries. Sales and service networks cover over 160 countries and regions worldwide, including North America, Europe, Australia, Southeast Asia, Latin America, and Japan. It maintains localized sales and service teams in key markets to support global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the solar industry supply chain. It manufactures core PV components (silicon wafers, cells, modules), integrates energy storage systems, and provides EPC services for PV power stations. It also engages in system integration and long-term maintenance services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solar and storage solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding N-type TOPCon production capacity, accelerating growth in large-scale energy storage, and enhancing integrated solar-storage solutions. R&D focuses on improving cell efficiency, reducing costs through advanced materials and manufacturing processes, developing next-generation battery technologies with longer life cycles, and innovating in inverter and PCS technologies. The company also invests in digital transformation and AI applications to optimize operations and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of PV modules, energy storage systems, and PV system components. Additional income streams include EPC contracting services, long-term maintenance and service contracts for energy storage projects, and sales of residential energy storage products through distribution channels. The company also benefits from government subsidies and incentives related to renewable energy.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading global PV module manufacturer and energy storage system integrator, consistently ranked in the top tier by Bloomberg New Energy Finance. It competes with major international solar and storage companies, leveraging its advanced technology, global production footprint, and extensive sales network. Its integrated solar-storage solutions and strong presence in key overseas markets differentiate it from many competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 46.17 billion, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.25 billion. Despite a 10% revenue decline due to market price pressures, energy storage sales grew over 500%, offsetting some component sales declines. The company maintains substantial assets totaling over RMB 65 billion and continues to invest in expanding production capacity and R&D, aiming for sustained growth in both PV and energy storage sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced, and cost-effective PV modules and energy storage solutions. Its value proposition includes leading-edge cell technologies (TOPCon, HJT, BC), integrated solar-storage systems with superior safety and efficiency, and a global localized service network. It differentiates through innovation in product design, manufacturing automation, and comprehensive solutions that reduce system costs and improve lifecycle performance, supporting customers' clean energy transition goals.
